Title: LMTY Honey Citrus Mint Ball
Body (HTML):
Bright citrus, cool mint, smooth green tea and honey sweetness in an easy-to-prepare concentrate. Enjoy it warm or iced.

How to make it: mix 1 part concentrate with 1 part water. Hot: microwave 60 to 90 seconds. Iced: pour over ice.

Size: 32 fl oz (946 mL), about 8 servings.

Ingredients: green tea, lemon verbena, spearmint, lemongrass, honey, cane sugar, citric acid, natural flavors. Contains caffeine.
